question: Ritesh and Gauri have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Ritesh is driving at 66 km/hr while Gauri is driving at 99 km/hr. Find the time taken by Gauri to reach Kanpur if Ritesh takes 9 hours.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time.

Ratio of speeds (Ritesh : Gauri) = 66 : 99 = 2 : 3

Ratio of time (Ritesh : Gauri) = 3 : 2

Time taken by Ritesh = 3 units = 9 hours ⇒ 1 unit = 3 hours

Time taken by Gauri = 2 units = 2 × 3 = 6 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 6 hours.**
